note: 24 paired scene cases, each tested at 4 cap heights, 96 rollouts. Eight environments from one seed, not eight independent seed batches. Compare heights within each start mode. Start modes may change other placements via random sampling. Videos show scene 0 of the measured batch. Termination by any agent ends the scene; leader success is not whole-task success. Contact force is net per foot, not contact-pair specific. Fast-foot duration is a proxy that includes walking and foot roll, not confirmed slip. Cap gap includes one physics step of delay.
